fusions.name: Gnawed Seam
fusions.desc: A quick gnawing strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Collapsed Burrow
fusions.desc: Drops a block of packed earth on the first enemy it meets, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Floorboards
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds and jinks you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Deep Warren Hours
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
